objective: Make Chohogi's session-level rules observable: remove stale install copies, connect Codex to canonical guidance and roles, and add a transcript-based adherence replay runner so a real Claude Code or Codex session can be checked against the naturalized rules instead of trusted.
requested: build adherence checkers and replay tests modeled on the external methodology's test code
state clearly which Chohogi assets were built from that MIT-licensed source
excluded: deleting any home-directory file (stale copies are moved to a backup folder)
copying the external test scripts verbatim
running unbounded live replays; live runs stay within evaluation-budget-policy.md
raw prompts, private reasoning, credentials, or tool payload bodies in replay results

requestedItems.description: Move install.sh-era copies (CLAUDE.md, Codex AGENTS.md, ~/.agents/chohogi, Chohogi skills in ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills, ~/.codex/agents TOMLs) to a backup folder and confirm guidance still reaches both hosts.
Connect Codex guidance and roles by symlink to canonical files and verify in a fresh Codex session.
Transcript-based adherence runner, scenarios for the naturalized rules, offline analyzer tests, and at least one live run per host.
Third-party notice naming the MIT source and each Chohogi asset derived from it.

acceptance.description: A fresh Claude Code session and a fresh Codex session each show Chohogi guidance, and Codex lists the three Chohogi roles.
All Chohogi verifiers and the unittest suite pass.
